# VISUAL_SPEC.md

## 1. Global Canvas & Grid

- **Screenshot 3 (New Chat State)**: 806×1400 px

  - Same 32 px horizontal padding pattern

## 2. Color Tokens

| Token name | Hex | Usage examples |
|------------|-----|----------------|
| --bg-primary | #0A0A0A | Main application background |
| --bg-secondary | #111111 | Sidebar background |
| --bg-tertiary | #1A1A1A | Card/section backgrounds |
| --bg-hover | #1F1F1F | Hover state for interactive elements |
| --bg-active | #2A2A2A | Active/selected state |
| --text-primary | #FFFFFF | Primary text (headings, body) |
| --text-secondary | #9CA3AF | Secondary text, labels |
| --text-tertiary | #6B7280 | Muted text, timestamps |
| --text-link | #60A5FA | Interactive text links |
| --border-default | #2A2A2A | Default borders |
| --border-subtle | #1F1F1F | Subtle dividers |
| --accent-primary | #3B82F6 | Primary accent (buttons, badges) |
| --accent-secondary | #8B5CF6 | Secondary accent |
| --surface-overlay | rgba(0,0,0,0.5) | Modal/overlay backgrounds |

## 3. Typography Scale

- **text-heading-lg**: System UI, 600, 24px, 32px line-height, -0.02em
- **text-heading-md**: System UI, 600, 18px, 24px line-height, -0.01em  
- **text-body**: System UI, 400, 14px, 20px line-height, normal
- **text-body-sm**: System UI, 400, 13px, 18px line-height, normal
- **text-caption**: System UI, 400, 12px, 16px line-height, normal
- **text-mono**: SF Mono/Consolas, 400, 13px, 20px line-height, normal

## 4. Component Inventory

- Icon: 16×16 px, 2px stroke

- Background: --bg-tertiary

- States:
  - Default: --bg-tertiary

- **Hover transitions**: 150ms ease-out on background-color
- **Focus outlines**: 2px solid --accent-primary with 2px offset
- **Button press**: scale(0.98) transform
- **Dropdown animation**: 200ms ease-out slide down

## 8. Responsive Hints

- **Breakpoints**:

+

+             placeholder="Search..."

+           />
+         </div>
+       </div>
+ 
+       {/* Center section - Navigation Tabs */}
+       <nav
+         className="flex items-center gap-6"
+         role="navigation"
+         aria-label="Main navigation"
+       >
+         <Button
+           variant="ghost"
+           size="sm"
+           className="text-[#9CA3AF] transition-colors hover:bg-[#1F1F1F] hover:text-white"
+           aria-label="Create new item"
+         >
+           <Plus className="mr-2 size-4" />
+           Create
+         </Button>
+ 
+         <Button
+           variant="ghost"
+           size="sm"
+           className="text-[#9CA3AF] transition-colors hover:bg-[#1F1F1F] hover:text-white"

+           Market
+         </Button>
+ 
+         <Button
+           variant="ghost"
+           size="sm"
+           className="text-[#9CA3AF] transition-colors hover:bg-[#1F1F1F] hover:text-white"
+           aria-label="Learning resources"
+         >
+           Learn
+         </Button>
+ 
+         <Button
+           variant="ghost"
+           size="sm"
+           className="text-[#9CA3AF] transition-colors hover:bg-[#1F1F1F] hover:text-white"

+           Plan
+         </Button>
+       </nav>
+ 
+       {/* Right section - User Profile */}
+       <div className="flex items-center gap-3">

```diff
- 
+ # Three-Column Dashboard Layout Implementation
+ 
+ ## Overview
+ 
+ This document describes the implementation of a three-column dashboard layout according to the visual specification. The layout provides a modern, efficient workspace with dedicated areas for navigation, content, and AI chat functionality.
+ 
+ ## Architecture
+ 
+ ### Layout Structure
+ ```
+ ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
+ │                        AppHeader (56px)                     │
+ ├──────────┬─────────────────────────────────┬────────────────┤
+ │          │                                 │                │
+ │ AppSidebar│        Main Content            │   ChatPanel    │
+ │ (112px)  │       (Flexible)               │   (776px)      │
+ │          │                                 │                │
+ │          │                                 │                │
+ └──────────┴─────────────────────────────────┴────────────────┘
+ ```
+ 
+ ### Component Hierarchy
+ - **AppContainer**: Root layout container
+   - **AppSidebar**: Left navigation panel (112px fixed)
+   - **Main Content Area**: Flexible center column
+     - **AppHeader**: Top navigation bar (56px height)
+     - **Main Content**: Dashboard pages content
+   - **ChatPanel**: Right AI chat panel (776px fixed)
+ 
+ ## Key Components
+ 
+ ### 1. AppContainer (`app-container.tsx`)
+ **Purpose**: Root layout component implementing the three-column structure
+ 
+ **Features**:
+ - Full viewport height layout
+ - Flexbox-based column arrangement
+ - Dark theme background (`#0A0A0A`)
+ - Proper ARIA roles and accessibility
+ 
+ **Structure**:
+ ```tsx
+ <div className="flex h-screen bg-[#0A0A0A]">
+   <SidebarProvider>
+     <AppSidebar />
+   </SidebarProvider>
+   <div className="flex-1 flex flex-col">
+     <AppHeader />
+     <main>{children}</main>
+   </div>
+   <ChatPanel />
+ </div>
+ ```
+ 
+ ### 2. AppHeader (`app-header.tsx`)
+ **Purpose**: Top navigation bar with logo, search, tabs, and user profile
+ 
+ **Features**:
+ - 56px fixed height
+ - Sticky positioning
+ - Logo with brand identity
+ - Global search functionality
+ - Navigation tabs (Create, Market, Learn, Plan)
+ - User profile with avatar
+ 
+ **Key Elements**:
+ - Logo: Zap icon with "Intentified" branding
+ - Search: Input with search icon
+ - Navigation: Action buttons for main features
+ - User: Avatar and profile access
+ 
+ ### 3. AppSidebar (`app-sidebar.tsx`)
+ **Purpose**: Left navigation panel with main application navigation
+ 
+ **Features**:
+ - 112px fixed width
+ - Collapsible to icon-only mode
+ - Main navigation sections
+ - Secondary navigation (Support, Feedback, Settings)
+ - User profile in footer
+ 
+ **Navigation Structure**:
+ - **Platform**: Dashboard, Leads, Reports, Analytics, Pipelines
+ - **Workspaces**: Project-specific areas
+ - **Secondary**: Support, Feedback, Settings
+ 
+ ### 4. ChatPanel (`chat-panel.tsx`)
+ **Purpose**: Right panel for AI chat functionality
+ 
+ **Features**:
+ - 776px fixed width
+ - Model selector dropdown
+ - Chat prompts and suggestions
+ - Message input with voice/mention support
+ - Scrollable chat history
+ 
+ **Layout Sections**:
+ - Header: Model selector and new chat button
+ - Content: Welcome message and chat prompts
+ - Input: Message composition with tools
+ 
+ ## Data Flow
+ 
+ ### Sidebar Navigation
+ 1. Navigation items defined in `sidebar-menus.tsx`
+ 2. Active state management via `useActiveMenu` hook
+ 3. Collapsible behavior with localStorage persistence
+ 4. Responsive icon-only mode for smaller screens
+ 
+ ### Chat Functionality
+ 1. Model selection state management
+ 2. Message input handling
+ 3. Chat prompt suggestions
+ 4. Voice input and mention support
+ 
+ ### Layout State
+ 1. Sidebar open/closed state persistence
+ 2. Responsive breakpoint handling
+ 3. Client-side hydration with skeleton loading
+ 
+ ## Styling & Design Tokens
+ 
+ ### Color Palette
+ ```css
+ --bg-primary: #0A0A0A     /* Main background */
+ --bg-secondary: #111111   /* Sidebar/header background */
+ --bg-tertiary: #1A1A1A    /* Card backgrounds */
+ --bg-hover: #1F1F1F       /* Hover states */
+ --bg-active: #2A2A2A      /* Active states */
+ --text-primary: #FFFFFF   /* Primary text */
+ --text-secondary: #9CA3AF /* Secondary text */
+ --text-tertiary: #6B7280  /* Muted text */
+ --border-default: #2A2A2A /* Borders */
+ --accent-primary: #3B82F6 /* Primary accent */
+ ```
+ 
+ ### Typography
+ - **Headings**: System UI, 600 weight
+ - **Body**: System UI, 400 weight, 14px
+ - **Small**: System UI, 400 weight, 13px
+ - **Caption**: System UI, 400 weight, 12px
+ 
+ ### Spacing
+ - **Sidebar**: 8px padding, 4px item gaps
+ - **Header**: 24px horizontal padding
+ - **Content**: 24px padding
+ - **Chat**: 32px horizontal padding
+ 
+ ## Responsive Behavior
+ 
+ ### Breakpoints
+ - **Desktop (>1024px)**: Full three-column layout
+ - **Tablet (768-1024px)**: Sidebar collapses to icons
+ - **Mobile (<768px)**: Chat panel becomes overlay
+ 
+ ### Adaptive Features
+ - Sidebar auto-collapse on smaller screens
+ - Chat panel overlay mode for mobile
+ - Touch-friendly interaction targets
+ - Keyboard navigation support
+ 
+ ## Accessibility Features
+ 
+ ### ARIA Implementation
+ - **Sidebar**: `role="navigation"` with proper labeling
+ - **Main**: `role="main"` for content area
+ - **Chat**: `role="complementary"` for chat panel
+ - **Interactive Elements**: Proper ARIA labels and states
+ 
+ ### Keyboard Navigation
+ - Tab order follows logical flow
+ - Focus indicators on all interactive elements
+ - Keyboard shortcuts for common actions
+ - Screen reader announcements
+ 
+ ### Visual Accessibility
+ - High contrast color ratios (21:1 for primary text)
+ - Focus indicators with 2px outlines
+ - Consistent hover and active states
+ - Scalable icon system
+ 
+ ## Performance Considerations
+ 
+ ### Optimization Strategies
+ - **Component Memoization**: React.memo for stable components
+ - **State Management**: Minimal re-renders with proper state structure
+ - **Lazy Loading**: Chat messages and large lists
+ - **Virtual Scrolling**: For extensive navigation or chat history
+ 
+ ### Bundle Optimization
+ - Tree-shaking friendly exports
+ - Minimal external dependencies
+ - Efficient icon usage (Lucide React)
+ - CSS-in-JS optimization
+ 
+ ## Integration Points
+ 
+ ### Dashboard Pages
+ All dashboard pages now render within the three-column layout:
+ ```tsx
+ // Dashboard page structure
+ <DashboardLayoutWrapper>
+   <YourPageContent />
+ </DashboardLayoutWrapper>
+ ```
+ 
+ ### State Management
+ - Sidebar state persisted in localStorage
+ - Chat state managed locally
+ - Navigation active states via URL matching
+ 
+ ### API Integration
+ - Chat functionality ready for AI service integration
+ - Navigation items configurable via data layer
+ - User profile data from Clerk authentication
+ 
+ ## Future Enhancements
+ 
+ ### Planned Features
+ 1. **Chat History**: Persistent conversation storage
+ 2. **Workspace Switching**: Dynamic sidebar content
+ 3. **Theme Customization**: Light/dark mode toggle
+ 4. **Layout Preferences**: User-configurable panel sizes
+ 5. **Mobile Optimization**: Enhanced responsive behavior
+ 
+ ### Extension Points
+ - Plugin system for additional panels
+ - Customizable navigation sections
+ - Theming system for brand customization
+ - Advanced chat features (file upload, code highlighting)
+ 
+ ## Testing Strategy
+ 
+ ### Component Testing
+ - Unit tests for individual components
+ - Integration tests for layout behavior
+ - Accessibility testing with screen readers
+ - Visual regression testing
+ 
+ ### User Experience Testing
+ - Navigation flow validation
+ - Responsive behavior verification
+ - Performance benchmarking
+ - Cross-browser compatibility
+ 
+ ## Maintenance Guidelines
+ 
+ ### Code Organization
+ - Components grouped by feature area
+ - Shared utilities in common directories
+ - Type definitions co-located with components
+ - Documentation updated with changes
+ 
+ ### Performance Monitoring
+ - Bundle size tracking
+ - Runtime performance metrics
+ - User interaction analytics
+ - Error boundary implementation
+ 
+ This implementation provides a solid foundation for the dashboard application with room for future enhancements and customization.
